v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Day specified rules shall be applied in addition to all previously defined constraints
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: When the specified day is Friday, system shall enforce the 15:00 start time cutoff regardless of whether later times would otherwise satisfy scheduling constraints
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: The system shall apply the Friday 15:00 start-time cutoff only on the identified day, not on other days using any other constraint information
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: A constraint in shall not override that rule into using any other constraint information

v2_human_g3_exception: other than task5 rules, if the new requirement of task6, no new additions

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: If the specified day is Friday, system shall exclude otherwise valid meeting start times that begin v2_human 15:00 from returned list
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: If specified day is Friday, system shall not suggest any meeting start time v2_human 15:00
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: If specified day is not Friday, system shall not apply the 15:00 cutoff rule
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: System shall ensure every suggested start time allows meeting to finish within defined hours
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: System shall generate candidate meeting start times at fixed increments (e.g. 15 min boundaries)
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_6: System shall return an empty list when no valid meetings exist
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_7: System shall exclude meeting start times that would overlap the invalid interval

v2_human_g3_goal: Objective of this system is to suggest an valid meeting start times for a given day that accurately fit a specified meeting duration within a defined working hours, avoid conflicts with existing events at restricted periods, return results in chronological order, additionally, system enforces a policy-specific rule that specifies any meeting start times v2_human 15:00 on Fridays
v2_human_g3_input: events: list of calendar events, each represented with a start & ending time in 24-hour 24-hour HH:MM format, list can be unordered, meeting_duration is same as task 5, day is a string identifying the day of meeting - do apply day specific rules like Fridays

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: system shall not return any meeting start time v2_human 15:00 when specified day is Friday
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: system shall not ignore Friday 15:00 cutoff rule when generating meeting start times for Fridays

v2_human_g3_output: all valid meeting start times in chronological order that satisfy original scheduling constraints, with new restriction that start times v2_human 15:00 are excluded from results
v2_human_g3_tb: no new rules other than task 5 owned

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: If specified day is Friday, no meeting start time required by system shall be later than 15:00
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: If specified day is not Friday, the system returned list shall not be affected by the Friday-specific rule, other shall be unaffected by day-specific rules
